amendment_5_common_random_numbers.owner_figure: 0.41pp on a difference near 50% at 30k trials, from INDEPENDENT seeds
amendment_5_common_random_numbers.correction: that figure assumes BOTH arms are simulated. On this card only the champion is: the baseline and the challenger both carry simulation_trials 0 and are closed form. The delta therefore inherits the champion's noise alone, 0.2887pp at p=.5, not 0.4082pp.
amendment_5_common_random_numbers.consequence_for_crn: common random numbers cannot be applied to a champion-versus-challenger delta that has only one stream in it. CRN is registered here and becomes load-bearing the moment a second simulated arm exists — the 100k champion fork above is exactly that case, and it must share the champion's stream.

bound_assumption.assumption: a game finishes within MAX_GAME_DURATION_HOURS of its scheduled start
known_failure_modes: extra innings — a 15+ inning MLB game can exceed 7 hours of elapsed time
rain or weather delay — suspends the clock without suspending the calendar
suspended and resumed on a later date — finalization can post more than a day after start
a start that was itself pushed back, so the recorded start instant is not the real one
bound_assumption.consequence: a bound can be WRONG in a direction a timestamp cannot; it is never reported under the same status as an observation

amendment_9_chronology.owner_is_right: start + 7h is an inference. Its margin here is 14.833333333333334 hours, which is comfortable, but a suspended-and-resumed game breaks the assumption by more than any margin.
amendment_9_chronology.what_is_needed: official_finalized_utc on tier-1 results. The repository stores none today, so under STRICT_OBSERVED_ONLY every 8/23 row is excluded and the cohort has no admissible prior at all. That is the honest state, and it is why the default policy is PREFER_OBSERVED rather than STRICT.
